message:
Mike, I'm so impressed with what you're doing and am reading each post with a great deal of satisfaction and a few questions.  Maybe you've already written about this, but----is this school an English speaking school, or are you mentoring a cohort who teaches in English (like an immersion school)?

At any rate, what you're writing about would make a terrific article/book in the future. So get out your envelope. . .
